protozoanDetails.lifeCycleForm: Oocyst (infectious, environmentally resistant) containing sporozoites; intracellular (but extracytoplasmic) developmental stages within intestinal epithelial cells

habitat.naturalHabitat: Intestinal epithelium of humans and many other mammals
habitat.hostAssociation: Zoonotic — cattle and other livestock are important reservoirs
habitat.environmentalOccurrence: Oocysts are highly resistant to chlorination and can survive for extended periods in water
habitat.reservoir: Infected humans and animals (especially cattle); contaminated water supplies

microscopy.stain: Modified acid-fast (Kinyoun) stain of stool; immunofluorescence antibody testing
microscopy.appearance: Small, round, acid-fast (pink-red) oocysts against a blue-green background

culture.media: Not routinely cultured in clinical laboratories
culture.growthCharacteristics: Obligate intracellular parasite — no clinically practical in vitro culture

identificationClues: Small, acid-fast oocysts on modified Kinyoun stain of stool
Oocysts resistant to standard chlorination — outbreaks linked to recreational and municipal water
Stool antigen (EIA) or PCR testing increasingly used for diagnosis
Causes profuse watery diarrhea, often self-limited in immunocompetent hosts but severe/chronic in AIDS patients

diseases: Chronic, severe diarrhea and wasting in advanced HIV/AIDS
clinicalImportance.transmission: Fecal-oral, including contaminated drinking and recreational water (resistant to chlorine); person-to-person and zoonotic (cattle) transmission
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: A leading cause of waterborne outbreaks of diarrheal illness worldwide, including in treated municipal water supplies and swimming pools
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: Standard ova and parasite exams may miss oocysts unless a specific acid-fast stain or antigen/PCR test is requested

examFacts.importantTest: Modified acid-fast stain of stool; stool antigen or PCR
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: Oocysts are notably resistant to routine chlorination of water supplies
